title: UK Clearing Advisor - Data Freshness & Scraper Health
description: At-a-glance check that the daily/Results-Day scraper is running on schedule and that clearing-page data shown on the live site is current. Separate from the 'Access & Geography' dashboard - this one is about data trust, not traffic.

panels.title: Last successful scrape
panels.description: Time since DailyScraper last completed a full run (logs 'scrape complete'). If this grows well beyond the current scraper interval (10-30 min around Results Day, otherwise hourly/daily), the schedule has stopped firing or the function is failing before it finishes.

targets.expression: filter msg = 'scrape complete' | stats latest(@timestamp) as lastScrape | sort lastScrape desc | limit 1

panels.title: DLQ messages waiting (failed invocations)
panels.description: Messages in ClearingAdvisor-DailyScraperDLQ - a scrape run that failed both automatic Lambda retries and was routed here by the OnFailure destination. Should be 0. Any non-zero value means real scrape failures are going unnoticed.

panels.title: Scrape errors (last 24h)
panels.description: ScraperErrorCount metric, summed - individual clearing-page fetch failures within a run (network/timeout/DNS), NOT the same as a whole-run DLQ failure. A handful is normal (some university sites are flaky); a sustained high count means something changed.

panels.title: Clearing pages currently unreachable / blocked
panels.description: Most recent ClearingPageUnreachableCount + ClearingPageBlockedCount from the latest run - how many universities' clearing links are currently flagged dead or anti-bot-blocked to students. This is expected to be non-zero (some university sites genuinely move pages) - watch the trend, not just the number.

panels.title: Scraper invocation history (invocations / errors / throttles)
panels.description: AWS/Lambda service metrics for the DailyScraper function itself - a direct record of the schedule actually firing, and whether each invocation errored or was throttled (concurrency limit hit), independent of the application-level metrics above.

panels.title: Changes detected per run
panels.description: ScraperChangesDetected per run - how many universities' clearing-page status appeared to change since the previous check. Context for the invocation history above: a run with 0 changes and 0 errors is a normal, healthy 'nothing changed today' result, not a sign the scraper did nothing.

panels.title: Data age per university (stalest first)
panels.description: Time since each university's clearing page was last checked by the scraper - from the 'university-check' log line written on every run. Universities at the top of this list have the oldest data currently shown to students; if any entry is far older than the current scraper interval, that university is being skipped or failing silently before its log line writes.

targets.expression: filter msg = 'university-check' | stats latest(checkedAt) as lastChecked, latest(clearingPageStatus) as status by universityName | sort lastChecked asc
